header.title: Get started
header.description: Create your organization or ask your organization owner to send you an invitation.

organization.title: Create your organization
organization.description: Set up your profile, choose your role as media owner and/or advertiser — you can update this later from your organization overview.

stripe.title: Connect Stripe
stripe.description: Link your Stripe account so you can receive payments from advertisers.

campaign.description: Set up your first advertising campaign to start reaching your audience.

organization.prompt: Let's start by creating your organization
organization.hint: Choose your role as media owner and/or advertiser. You'll only need to do this once — roles can be updated later from your organization overview.

homepage.heroDescription: Broadcast your message across {count} digital screens strategically placed throughout the South Shore and the Island of Montreal — every 2 to 3 minutes.

timeline.subtitle: From first meeting to going live on screen, in 5 simple steps.

step1.title: Book a Meeting
step1.description: Schedule a quick call so we can understand your goals and recommend the right screens.

step2.title: Choose & Submit
step2.description: Pick the subscription that fits your budget and upload your ad creative.

step3.title: Secure Checkout
step3.description: Review your order and pay securely — no back-and-forth, no hidden fees.

step4.title: Track Your Campaign
step4.description: Watch impressions and results roll in live from your dashboard.

step5.title: Renew or Scale
step5.description: Extend, tweak, or scale up your campaign whenever you're ready — flexible terms, fast go-live.

footer.tagline: Digital ads on real screens across Greater Montreal.
